dedupe_keys.name: spisek vodnih crpalisc s podatki o precrpanih kolicinah vode obcini litija

description: Spisek vodnih črpališč s podatki o prečrpanih količinah vode občini Litija is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA LITIJA. Pumps are facilities for collecting, preparing and storing water and supplying water to consumers through a regional or mains water supply network. They belong to the infrastructure of local importance. Coverage: OBČINA LITIJA. The portal shows the English title as "List of water pumping stations with information on the quantities of water pumped to the municipality of Litija" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA LITIJA. Its keywords include oskrba z vodo, vodovod. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
